patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Clearbit and Kaspr share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Clearbit only if your buying job matches “HubSpot-owned enrichment (Clearbit → Breeze Intelligence) for CRM fill and inbound intelli” rather than Kaspr's shape. Choose Kaspr only if your buying job matches “LinkedIn-centric EU/EMEA B2B contact capture (Chrome) — Free plan; Starter from $49/mo ann” rather than Clearbit's shape. Workflow advantage: Clearbit leans contact-management; Kaspr leans prospecting, lead-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Clearbit and Kaspr share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Clearbit is HubSpot-owned enrichment (Clearbit → Breeze Intelligence) for CRM fill and inbound intelligence — usage/credits via HubSpot, Starter+ requir; Kaspr is LinkedIn-centric EU/EMEA B2B contact capture (Chrome) — Free plan; Starter from $49/mo annual headline..
- Company-size focus: Clearbit (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Kaspr (small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Clearbit-leaning contact-management vs Kaspr-leaning prospecting, lead-management.
- Researched limits: Clearbit — Now HubSpot-owned and repositioned as Breeze Intelligence — buying motion is HubSpot-centric; Kaspr — LinkedIn-centric capture — coverage and compliance depend on LinkedIn workflow policies.

Limitations — Clearbit: Now HubSpot-owned and repositioned as Breeze Intelligence — buying motion is HubSpot-centric; No standalone free plan; typically needs HubSpot Starter+; Kaspr: LinkedIn-centric capture — coverage and compliance depend on LinkedIn workflow policies; Native email outreach/sequencing depth is limited versus engagement platforms.

Poor-fit cases: Clearbit is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Now HubSpot-owned and repositioned as Breeze Intelligence — buying motion is HubSpot-centric · Kaspr is a poor fit when that limitation bites: LinkedIn-centric capture — coverage and compliance depend on LinkedIn workflow policies · Avoid Clearbit if you actually need Kaspr's motion (LinkedIn-centric EU/EMEA B2B contact capture (Chrome) — Free plan; Starter from )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
